subject: MedAxis: scoped authn log slices, SOC 2 Type II copy, and bridge letter timing
messages:
From: Eli Moreno <eli.moreno@medaxis.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Anika Patel <anika.patel@medaxis.com>, security@medaxis.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 artifacts + scoped authn logs (audit period clarification)

Hi Hannah,

We're kicking off our vendor audit for H1 and need a couple things from Redwood to close out our access controls scope. Can you share the following by EOD 2027-04-09?

- SOC 2 Type II report that covers July 1, 2026 — Jan 31, 2027 (PDF) and any bridge letter that explains coverage for systems where the auditor noted timing gaps.
- Scoped authentication logs for the audit period: MFA events (success/failure), SAML assertions, and privileged account deprovision events. We only need sample slices (not a full export): one representative week from each quarter in the audit period plus the most recent 30-day high-traffic window.
- Access review evidence: last recertification report and a list of privileged accounts that were removed during the period.

Can you confirm whether you can deliver pseudonymized logs (hashed user ids) and whether you support SFTP transfer to our secure intake? Also let us know the expected ETA and any constraints (PII redaction, retention windows, etc.).

Thanks — appreciate your help on a tight timeline.

Best,
Eli Moreno
Senior Security Engineer
MedAxis Health
[Attachment: MedAxis_SOW_and_questions.xlsx]

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eli Moreno <eli.moreno@medaxis.com>
Cc: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 artifacts + scoped authn logs (audit period clarification)

Eli — thanks for the clear list. We can support the request; below is our proposed deliverable plan and a couple of clarifying questions.

Deliverables (targeted):
- SOC 2 Type II PDF covering 2026-07-01 — 2027-01-31 ("SOC2_TypeII_2026-07_2027-01.pdf")
- Bridge letter draft that explains any control coverage gaps and compensating controls (we'll provide within the same package)
- AuthN log slices (CSV): MFA events (success/failure), SAML assertion trace samples, privileged deprovision events. Files will be pseudonymized (SHA256 hashed user identifiers) and timestamps in UTC.
- Access review artifacts: latest recert report (PDF) and a CSV of privileged accounts removed during the period.

Clarifying Qs:
1) You asked for "one week per quarter + recent 30-day" — can we deliver Q3 week = 2026-08-09–2026-08-15, Q4 week = 2026-11-08–2026-11-14, Q1 week = 2027-01-10–2027-01-16, plus the rolling most-recent 30-day (to be fixed at export time)? If you have different windows you prefer, please reply with exact dates.
2) Preferred transfer: we can push to your SFTP endpoint (you control credentials) or we can stage in a customer-specific, access-controlled Google Drive folder. Which do you prefer?

Constraints/notes:
- Pseudonymization: we will hash user IDs and will not include raw email addresses without a signed data-mapping agreement.
- Export ETA: once windows are agreed, expect 5 business days to produce, internally review, and redact per policy. Bridge letter draft will be ready within 3 business days.

I've attached an artifact checklist to this reply to help keep items tracked. If that timeline works I will kick this to Olga and the infra team to generate the extracts.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: artifact_delivery_checklist.xlsx]

From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Eli Moreno <eli.moreno@medaxis.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedAxis: scoped authn log slices, SOC 2 Type II copy, and bridge letter timing

Hannah / team — operational notes for export: 

- We can produce the three quarter weeks + rolling 30-day sample as CSVs. Exports will include: event_time_utc, event_type (MFA_SUCCESS / MFA_FAIL / SAML_ASSERTION / ADMIN_DEPROVISION), subject_hash (SHA256), ip_address (last 3 octets masked), user_agent.
- Privileged deprovision records: we will include before/after role assignment lines with admin who performed the change (hashed).
- We will not include authentication cookies or full tokens. Any SAML assertion raw blobs will be redacted except for assertion id and timestamp.
- Key rotation note: there was a scheduled KMS key rotation 2026-12-05 that did not affect event generation; events are continuous but some older session artifacts were re-issued. I'll add a short note in the delivery package to explain this so auditors have context.

ETA: 5 business days after windows confirmation to produce CSVs + internal review. I will also draft the bridge letter and coordinate a quick internal legal review before sending.

Proposed file names (examples):
- authn_mfa_slice_q3q4_2026_2027.csv
- saml_assertion_traces_sample.csv
- privileged_deprovision_2026-07_2027-01.csv
- SOC2_TypeII_2026-07_2027-01.pdf
- bridge_letter_medaxis_draft.docx

Transfer: SFTP is fine. We will ask for a write-only user account so we can push the files directly. If you prefer Drive, we will share a folder link and configure a short TTL.

I'll proceed when Hannah confirms the date windows and transfer method.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Principal, Controls & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: planned_export_examples.txt]

From: Eli Moreno <eli.moreno@medaxis.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Anika Patel <anika.patel@medaxis.com>, security@medaxis.com
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedAxis: scoped authn log slices, SOC 2 Type II copy, and bridge letter timing

Hi Hannah / Olga — thanks, that plan looks good. Quick confirmations before you start: 

- Windows: the ones you proposed are acceptable (Q3: 2026-08-09–08-15, Q4: 2026-11-08–11-14, Q1: 2027-01-10–01-16, plus the most recent 30-day ending on the export date).
- Transfer: SFTP write-only account is preferred. I will ask infra to create credentials and send them to your team (security@medaxis.com will send the details).
- Mapping file: we accept pseudonymized IDs but will need a secure, auditable mapping under a separate data mapping agreement if auditors request identity resolution. Please include a note in the package that mapping exists and whom to contact to request it (we will not exchange the mapping without a formal request).
- KMS rotation: please include the short explanatory note in the delivery package. That will save follow-ups.

If you can push the SOC 2 PDF + bridge draft first, we can start our internal review while you work on the CSV slices. Appreciate the ETA of ~5 business days.

Best,
Eli
Senior Security Engineer, MedAxis Health
